scope: Local synthetic admission and runtime fixtures; no live testing or deployment

checks.name: Full parallel Auth suite, including enabled pacing and unknown-score fixture

acceptance_evidence: Thirty independent concurrent D1 admission callers retain exact accepted shared/profile accounting.
Repeated profile denials leave shared capacity unchanged; a second profile admits successfully.
One hundred further admissions advance synthetic time instead of spinning and preserve reserve.
Header observations never refill capacity already spent by concurrent reservations.
Injected second-update storage error rolls back both reservations.
429/reset and success retain hard cooldown while recovery declines gradually.
Enabled Worker read fixture refuses before upstream HTTP; revocation still returns 401.
Ambiguous score retains the original unknown receipt and exactly one POST with adaptive pacing enabled.
Expiry cleanup retains active cooldown; profile deletion cascades profile state.
limitations: ADAPTIVE_PACING_ENABLED ships false in all environments; activation and real traffic qualification remain separate release gates.
Per-profile ceilings and atomic reservations bound shared-capacity consumption; no strict FIFO or independent-client coordination is claimed.
Auth migration 0008 is required before the corresponding bundle runs.
